_readme: The world, one district at a time. Add an entry, run build_district.py <id>, then check.py <id>. Bboxes are OSM order: south,west,north,east. Keep them under ~1.2km on the long side or Overpass times out.

districts.name: Orchard Road
districts.notes: The full 2,586m of Orchard Road, Tanglin junction through to Dhoby Ghaut. The earlier box covered only the middle 1,119m (43%).

districts.name: Somerset / Dhoby Ghaut
districts.notes: Continues Orchard east: 313, Orchard Gateway, The Cathay, Plaza Singapura.

districts.name: Tanglin
districts.notes: Continues Orchard west: Tanglin Mall, Forum, St Regis, the Botanic Gardens edge.

districts.name: Bugis / Rochor
districts.notes: Shophouse-heavy, so the shophouse recipe should carry most of it.

districts.name: Chinatown / Telok Ayer
districts.notes: Densest shophouse fabric in the city; good test of the terrace variants.

districts.name: Marina Bay
districts.notes: Towers and water. Needs a water surface, which nothing else has yet.
